subject.title: RFC: Period-based popularity for publishers, skills, and plugins

question: Should ClawHub sponsor the full shared weekly/monthly period-popularity contract before adding tabs, or keep only the existing seven-day skill/plugin trending surfaces for now?
rationale: Current main only implements partial skill/plugin trending foundations; the remaining publisher aggregation, scoring, attribution, and UI semantics are product choices with data-model consequences.

options.title: Build shared foundation first
options.body: Define period scoring and attribution, add publisher daily rollups plus weekly/monthly snapshots, then expose aligned tabs across publishers, skills, and plugins.

options.title: Keep existing trending only
options.body: Leave skill/plugin Trending as the current seven-day surface and defer publisher/monthly tabs until a later sponsored project.

options.title: Narrow to one surface
options.body: Approve a smaller RFC that ships period popularity for one surface with explicit labeling and without implying cross-surface semantic alignment.

recommendation.title: Build shared foundation first
recommendation.body: Define period scoring and attribution, add publisher daily rollups plus weekly/monthly snapshots, then expose aligned tabs across publishers, skills, and plugins.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent discovery-ranking and leaderboard work makes Vincent the strongest history-backed owner for the product/technical direction question.
